Added InstantiateReport.created (CreationRecord: path/sha256/bytes) as the requested creation receipt, and whole-batch rollback (restore-or-remove) on a mid-batch write failure, tested via a pub(crate) fault-injection hook mirroring project-files' own Hooks pattern. report.summary: FT-040 rev 2: crates/project-templates now reads/writes every declared file through flashtex-project-files' rooted, O_NOFOLLOW ProjectRoot/ProjectLock instead of raw fs calls, closing a symlink-follow-through gap rev 1 had; own path::validate (which refuses '..' outright, unlike ProjectPath's normalize-and-resolve) is kept as the sole judge of a raw declared path, so no rev 1 guarantee was traded away for the refactor. instantiate() now returns InstantiateReport.created: a CreationRecord (path, sha256, bytes) per file from the writer's own post-write verification. A mid-batch write failure now rolls back every file already written in that call (restore-to-original-bytes if it pre-existed, remove if newly created), proven by two tests that inject a failure via a pub(crate) test hook and assert no partial tree survives, including one proving overwritten files are restored to their original content rather than left half-replaced. Rev 1 preflight/overwrite-flag behavior and its tests are unchanged and still pass. 42 tests (34 unit + 7 integration + 1 doctest), clippy clean, fmt clean.
